notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey, Ironfreaks!💪 💪 💪[/b][/p][p] This month, I focused on refining the characters and their animations to make the in-game experience even more realistic and immersive.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495488/5942b0b8ed59472d7735c0db20ac0f9194b54070.jpg"][/img][/p][p]💪 [b]New Characters and Realistic Muscles[/b]
By popular demand, I worked on new characters to make them resemble real athletes as closely as possible. We introduced more detailed muscle and vein mapping, and the work on muscle movement is ongoing – I want every motion to look as natural and realistic as possible. I’ll continue developing this system in the coming months.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495488/9a41d8cb6b6d0197b77917ca696037ae07799530.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495488/b34a70c26941877127c4f5f991b44e44b51da18f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🏋️‍♂️ [b]New Exercises[/b]
We added 5 new exercises to better simulate different muscle groups:[/p][list][*][p]One-arm French press[/p][/*][*][p]Two-arm French press[/p][/*][*][p]Close-grip pull-ups[/p][/*][*][p]Wide-grip pull-ups[/p][/*][*][p]Push-ups[/p][/*][/list][p]🚶‍♂️ [b]Natural Movement System[/b]
I worked on the movement system to ensure that every animation – from running and walking to changing direction – looks smooth and realistic. This allows characters to move naturally and dynamically.[/p][p]😃 [b]Facial Animations and Expressions[/b]
I continued working on facial animations, both in the game’s story and during exercises. Now the characters’ emotions are better expressed, making interactions with the environment more immersive.[/p][p]💦 [b]Sweating[/b]
I’m continuing work on the sweating system, making it respond to physical effort and look as natural as possible. This makes exercises and character movement feel even more realistic.[/p][p]🧔 [b]Body Hair[/b]
I started working on body hair to make characters even more detailed and realistic. This is another step toward fully recreating real athletes in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495488/5397d17aa67dcc6d86d356055d972cd952cdb730.jpg"][/img][/p][p]That’s it for now. Thanks for checking out the latest devlog – more updates coming soon![/p][p]KlapsON[/p]

notes.title: 💪 Devlog #1 – Sweat, Muscles and Respect
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey, Ironfreaks!💪 💪 💪[/b][/p][p]Welcome to the [b]first devlog[/b] for this project. I'm developing this game solo, and from now on I’ll be sharing regular updates on what’s going on behind the scenes. Here's a quick look at the features I’ve been working on recently:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495488/c9e4fab571f83bb8e8f3f51384efc93619d658f9.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🧪 [b]Sweat Simulation[/b][/p][p]I’ve started developing a more advanced sweat system. Instead of just using textures, sweat will now appear as particles that respond to workout intensity. It will also show up on clothing, gradually soaking through as training progresses.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🏋️‍♂️ [b]New Exercises in Progress[/b][/p][p]I’ve begun implementing four new exercises:[/p][list][*][p]Barbell Squats[/p][/*][*][p]Deadlifts[/p][/*][*][p]Lateral Raises[/p][/*][*][p]Decline Bench Press[/p][/*][/list][p]Each exercise will come with its own animations and influence on muscle movement and tension.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🔬 [b]Muscle and Tendon System[/b][/p][p]I'm continuing work on the muscle and soft tissue system for both male and female characters. The focus is on how muscles, tendons, and tissues behave under strain. This will take time, but it's an important part of the game’s foundation and will continue to evolve in the coming months.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🏆 [b]Gym Respect Mechanic (Prototype Stage)[/b][/p][p]I’ve also started prototyping a [b]gym respect[/b] mechanic. The idea is to let players build a reputation at the gym through performance, consistency, and interaction. It’s still in early stages, but it should help create a more social and dynamic atmosphere.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]That’s it for now. Thanks for checking out the first devlog – more updates coming soon![/b][/p][p][b]KlapsON[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F0RBA5XB9sY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: [FAQ] - Answers to your questions
notes.notes:
[b]Hey, Ironfreaks!💪 💪 💪 [/b]

I’m an independent developer working solo on this game for the past few months. To keep things clear, I’ve put together a list of frequently asked questions about BODYBUILDER SIMULATOR CO-OP. Take a look, and let me know if there’s anything else you’d like to ask. Stay tuned for future updates!

[b]When will the game be released?[/b]
At this stage of development, I can’t provide an exact release date. However, I’m doing everything I can to launch it in the second half of 2026.

[b]How much will the game cost?[/b]
The price hasn't been set yet, but I can assure you it will be fair and appropriate for this type of game. In the future, as development progresses, I will announce the final price.

[b]Which platforms will the game be available on?[/b]
I’m planning to launch the game on PC first. If the community grows significantly, I’ll work on bringing it to Xbox and PlayStation as well.

[b]Will there be a co-op mode?[/b]
Yes! The game is designed from the ground up to support co-op for up to four players.

[b]Will there be a demo?[/b]
Yes, I plan to release a free demo on Steam before the full launch.

[b]Which engine is the game built on?[/b]
I’m developing the game in Unreal Engine 5.

[b]Will there be a story mode?[/b]
Yes, the game features a storyline that I’m continuously expanding. However, as a simulator, the main focus is on game mechanics, training your body, and gaining fitness knowledge.

[b]How can I support the project?[/b]
The best way to help is by adding the game to your Steam wishlist and engaging with me on Discord. Your support helps increase the game’s visibility and brings me closer to the release. If you haven’t added it to your wishlist yet, I’d really appreciate it—it makes a huge difference!

[b]Let me know if you have any questions or suggestions! 😊[/b]
